description: This file contains multiple strategies and rules for tensor sharding and distributed computation within the PyTorch distributed tensor framework. It defines how various tensor operations are mapped to distributed strategies, including sharding, replication, and reshaping to optimize distributed execution.

methods.name: StrategyType propagate_single_input_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Creates a distributed strategy for operations with a single tensor input by mapping each strategy to a corresponding one with the same tensor meta and mesh.

methods.name: StrategyType equal_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Defines sharding strategies for tensor comparison operations, ensuring consistent sharding layout for operands.

methods.name: StrategyType create_like_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Generates sharding strategies for tensor creation operations replicating or following input sharding, with adjustments from partial to replicate.

methods.name: StrategyType new_factory_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Provides strategies for tensor factory operations, either creating a replicated tensor or following input shape if shapes match.

methods.name: StrategyType gen_bucketize_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Propagates input tensor sharding and enforces replicated boundary inputs.

methods.name: StrategyType select_int_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Determines sharding strategies for the select operation, unsharding or reshaping tensors based on the selected dimension.

methods.name: OutputSharding prop_index_select(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Handles sharding logic for index select, propagating and adjusting specs based on input and index tensor sharding.

methods.name: StrategyType prop_index_put(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Defines strategies for index put operations, ensuring replicated indices and proper sharding alignment for values and input tensors.

methods.name: OutputSharding prop_index(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Determines sharding for index operations with complex rules depending on indexing tensors and values.

methods.name: StrategyType gen_slice_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Computes strategies for slicing tensors, unsharding the slice dimension if beneficial.

methods.name: OpStrategy slice_backward_rules(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Defines redistribution rules for the backward pass of slice operations, adjusting sharding along slice dimensions.

methods.name: tuple[Placement,...] unshard_tensor_dim( placements: Sequence[Placement], dim: int )
methods.description: Utility to convert sharded tensor dimensions to replicated, disallowing sharding along a specific dimension.

methods.name: tuple[Placement,...] replicate_tensor_dim( placements: Sequence[Placement], dim: int )
methods.description: Utility to enforce replication along a specific tensor dimension.

methods.name: StrategyType gen_slice_scatter_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Strategies for slice-scatter operations, either propagating sharding or falling back to replicated placements.

methods.name: StrategyType replica_only_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Strategy to enforce replication for specific operations, such as scalar extraction.

methods.name: StrategyType scatter_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Defines a full mesh sharding strategy for scatter operations, including optional in-place variants.

methods.name: StrategyType scatter_add_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Strategies for scatter-add, considering sharding on the specified dimension and matching tensor shapes.

methods.name: StrategyType gather_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Configures sharding for gather operations based on the gather dimension and index shape.

methods.name: shift_shard_dims_after_insert
methods.description: Adjusts sharding specifications after inserting a new dimension, propagating shard placements.

methods.name: shift_shard_dims_after_remove
methods.description: Adjusts sharding specifications after removing a dimension, adjusting shard placements accordingly.

methods.name: unshard_tensor_dim
methods.description: Utility disallowing sharding along a specified tensor dimension.

methods.name: propagate_single_input_strategy
methods.description: Creates strategies for ops with a single tensor input, creating strategies based on input strategies.

methods.name: StrategyType stack_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Defines how to distribute the stack operation, inserting a new dimension and adjusting sharding accordingly.

methods.name: StrategyType cat_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Determines sharding strategies for concatenation, unsharding tensors on the concatenation dimension if needed.

methods.name: StrategyType gen_unbind_strategy(op_schema: OpSchema)
methods.description: Provides strategies for unbind, avoiding sharding along the unbind dimension.
